title: Follow the evolution loop
description: You trace selection, retained candidates, and offspring through the genetic algorithm.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You configure a population of 60 for the supplied generation count and retain four elite candidates. evaluate calls fitness once for each candidate.
You seed the generator, sample a population, and sort by descending fitness each generation. The histories record that generation's best and mean before offspring creation.
You print selected generations and copy three population snapshots. Elitism copies the first four sorted candidates into new_pop.

steps.question: How does the loop fill the positions after the elite copies?
steps.answer: It selects two parents by tournament, applies crossover and mutation, and appends the child. It repeats until new_pop reaches pop_size, then evaluates the new population.

steps.description: You sort once more after the final offspring generation and return the arrays and snapshots. The recording ends with best_x=[0., -0.] and fitness -0.0.
